Name: JP's Debris Is In The Air - Night Lights
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center]﻿[/center]
[center][font=Georgia][b][i]﻿[color=#00ff00][size=6][u]DIITA - Night Lights[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b][/font][/center]


[font=Georgia][size=4]-------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]You can support me at [url=https://ko-fi.com/juanpa98ar]Ko-Fi[/url] or [url=https://buymeacoffee.com/juanpa98ar]BuyMeACoffee[/url]![/b]
[url=https://ko-fi.com/juanpa98ar][img]https://i.imgur.com/r8BhMYT.gif[/img]
[/url]------------------------------------------------------------------- [/size]


[b][i][color=#ff00ff][size=5]Because there's nothing more magical than beautiful lights when you're alone in the forest... They're firefly lights, right?... Right?...[/size][/color][/i][/b][/font]


[list]
[*][b][font=Georgia][size=4]This mod allows Baubles (those lights that appear in the secret forest) or fireflies to appear when night falls, throughout the entire outdoor area of the valley.[/size][/font][/b][/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b][font=Georgia][i][size=4]You can enable or disable effects at your current location by pressing the [color=#ffff00]“F7” key[/color] (by default; with GMCM you can change the key or key combination!) to open the options menu. Now with new options.[/size][/i][/font][/b][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][b]You can choose between Baubles (with colors predetermined according to the season or selected by you) or Fireflies (colors predetermined by season or selected by you), which will appear when the sun goes down. [/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Georgia][b][color=#00ff00]Spring and Autumn 07:00PM, Summer 08:00PM, Winter 06:00PM.[/color][/b][/font][/size]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]They are just a visual effect and nothing more, to add a little color to the valley. Fireflies do emit light, so they could help you on the darkest night of the year. [/b][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]The number of both depends on the size of the map.[/b][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/SRhMQC00/Tuto-Stardew-Valleyaderado.gif[/img]
[color=#00ff00][size=4][b][i][img]https://i.postimg.cc/bvz5tw63/DIITANBaub.gif[/img]﻿
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/7LmWMrcz/DIITANDust.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/xdt4yV7v/DIITANFire_Fade.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/R0XDQx8c/DIITANFire_Out.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Px7V9zdp/DIITANFire_Sta.gif[/img]
[/i][/b][/size][/color]
[color=#ff0000][size=5][b][i]They are purely cosmetic effects; they look nice.[/i][/b][/size][/color]



[size=5][i][color=#00ff00][size=5][b]That's it, GMCM is very necessary in this mod in order to configure the mod according to your preferences. You will find detailed information in each option. [/b][/size][/color][/i]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u][b]Translations[/b][/u][/size][/color][/i]
[b]You are free to translate the mod;[color=#ff0000] you don't need to ask my permission[/color][color=#ff0000].[/color]
[color=#00ff00]You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods.[/color]
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/b]
